notes: VAT 20% (Codul fiscal art. 96; legis.md consolidation in force from 21.12.2018 - arts. 96/103 substance stable). The full art. 103 and art. 104 lists were read: the only gold item exempts HS 7108 imports BY the National Bank of Moldova and supplies to/by it - retail bullion takes 20%; silver never mentioned. Duty null (TARIM not openable).

sources.name: Codul fiscal nr. 1163/1997 (legis.md official text), art. 96
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: the standard VAT rate is 20% of the taxable value of imported goods and services and of supplies in Moldova; the art. 103 list exempts only National Bank gold imports
sources.quote: Se stabilesc următoarele cote ale T.V.A.: a) cota-standard – în mărime de 20% din valoarea impozabilă a mărfurilor şi serviciilor importate şi a livrărilor efectuate pe teritoriul Republicii Moldova
